latestVersion.changelog:
Woodworking & Maker Basics v1.0.0 — Initial release

- Provides step-by-step introduction to basic woodworking for practical home projects.
- Outlines an affordable starter tool kit with must-have and nice-to-have recommendations.
- Offers clear guidance on wood selection, common types, sizing, and where to source materials cheaply or for free.
- Includes important localization notes (units, wood types, supplier chains, regulations).
- Lists trusted sources for techniques and beginner project plans.
- Details when and how to use the skill, e.g., for building, repairing, or starting woodworking as a hobby.
